CLAIMED bd-627z.1 (loop completion scoping + stranded-bead reclaim + close-evidence). Reserved: flywheel/src/{durable,main}.rs.

Reopened earlier this session (my previous session ended before code landed). Plan (narrow slice):
1. ReadyBead gains assignee (Option<String>, serde default); __inprogress leaf + parsers emit it.
2. Stranded reclaim: pure fn stranded_beads(inprogress, live_names) + __reclaim-stranded leaf (br update --status open --assignee ""); loop reclaims + re-dispatches same poll.
3. Scoped completion: inprogress_empty only counts LIVE-assignee beads (stranded reclaimed, not blocking); ready-beads-in-scope check added to the atomic completion re-check.
4. Close-evidence: loop warns when a scope bead closes without gate-evidence in the reason.
5. Tests: pure stranded-detection + scoped-completion predicates; live planted-stranded run.
